author: KEXP
description: Seattle band Heavy Bloom infuse their soulful sound with a blend of pop, R&B, and funk. Live on KEXP with host Larry Mizell, Jr., the band share a live performance of "Crash" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Heavy Bloom performs "Crash" & more Live on KEXP
